intro: Where ideas meet structure, Sync tables support collaborative thinking. Designed to host productive meetings with integrated connectivity.

features.title: Compact Circular Design
features.text: Round shape promotes face-to-face interaction, ideal for quick stand-ups, team huddles, or casual collaboration

features.title: Versatile Fit for Agile Spaces
features.text: Easily fits into open-plan layouts, lounges, or breakout areas—encouraging spontaneous meetings and creative flow.

features.title: Sleek Angled Legs
features.text: Modern, tapered metal legs offer strong support and add a refined visual balance to smaller spaces.

features.title: Soft Edge Detailing
features.text: Rounded tabletop edges enhance safety and comfort, especially in high-traffic or shared environments.

features.title: Integrated Cable Access
features.text: Features a central access port with a sleek cover, allowing provisions for seamless power connectivity for meetings.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
